title: What If the Moon Vanished Tonight?
premise: The Moon disappears instantly; nights darken, tides shrink to a third, Earth's tilt starts to wander.

title: What If Earth Stopped Spinning?
premise: Earth's rotation stops; air and oceans keep moving, days last a year, oceans drain to the poles.

title: What If Betelgeuse Exploded Tonight?
premise: Betelgeuse's supernova light reaches Earth; daylight-visible star, no danger, likely ~100,000 years off.

title: What If Every Insect Vanished Overnight?
premise: Every insect vanishes; birds lose 400-500M tonnes of prey a year, 87 of 115 leading crops need pollinators, staples survive, cacao relies on midges.

title: What If Humans Could Photosynthesize?
premise: Humans with photosynthetic skin: ~1 m² of sun at 4.6% max efficiency gives ~40 kcal/h, ~240 kcal a day vs 2,000 needed; sea slug Elysia chlorotica steals chloroplasts.

title: What If You Never Slept Again?
premise: Never sleeping: 17-19 h awake ≈ 0.05% BAC on tests, 264-hour 1964 record, sleep widens brain spaces 60% to clear waste (mice), frigatebirds sleep in flight with half a brain.

title: What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?
premise: Earth gains a rocky ring inside the Roche limit; sky views by latitude, ring shadow, and the 466-Myr-old ring hypothesis.

title: What If You Fell Into Jupiter?
premise: Sinking through Jupiter: Galileo probe entry and death at ~22 atm, no surface, metallic hydrogen, unknown core.

title: What If You Fell Through a Hole in the Earth?
premise: Gravity tunnel: 7.9 km/s at the center, 38 minutes one way, endless oscillation, air drag leaves you at the center.
